title: MWS Recruitment — Behavioral
description: Smoking, alcohol, and exercise behaviors reported at recruitment.

RSMOKE.title: Smoking status
RSMOKE.$comment: Source coding: 1 Never; 2 Past; 3 Current; 4 Not current. 'Past' and 'Not current' both appear in the source code list as distinct levels -- transcribed verbatim, not merged or interpreted.

RCIGSPD.title: Cigarettes per day (current smokers)
RCIGSPD.x-universe: Intended for current smokers (RSMOKE=3), per the source's own field description.
RCIGSPD.$comment: Source description says 'in current smokers', but the real question wording (steward-confirmed) is asked independently of smoking status -- a non-smoker answers '1=None' directly, a real substantive value, not a skip. No not-applicable branch -- D035, resolves D008.

RALCNUM.title: Alcoholic drinks per week
RALCNUM.x-derivation: Derived from reported weekly drinks of wine, lager, cider, beer, and spirits.
RALCNUM.$comment: Source states no valid range. 0-200 is an agent-decided plausibility ceiling (rejects impossible counts, permits rare heavy use) -- D019.

REXANY.title: Any exercise (times per week)
REXANY.$comment: Source's own code list includes -1=Not on questionnaire for this field (Blue version = No availability) -- kept as the source-documented sentinel. missing_numeric (-999) added alongside it per D020: -1 explains one specific reason a value is absent, not every possible one.

REXSTREN.title: Strenuous exercise (times per week)
REXSTREN.$comment: Unlike REXANY, the source's code list for this field has no -1 code (all versions = Yes availability) -- generic missing_numeric fallback applies instead.
